Achievements

Server-verified from your real trading record — earned once, kept forever.

XP prices deduct from your XP but a purchase can never cost you a level — the shop refuses any spend that would drop you below your current level's threshold. Balance purchases are deducted from your withdrawable rewards balance and are final. Equipped frames show on your public trader card, chat and leaderboards.
